title: lst-dark-composites: code for 'Dark composites are unrecoverable: an identifiability limit on gap-filling of MODIS land surface temperature'
description: Python code and Google Earth Engine export script reproducing all results of the paper: gap statistics, hold-out experiments and remedies for dark MODIS LST composites at five Indian tiles (2015-2025).
